purpose: No-provider policy for mapping internal prosody plans into future ElevenLabs-safe text, style, and voice-setting metadata without generating audio or changing live runtime behavior.
safety_rules: no raw bracket tags in spoken text
no raw URLs unless explicit metadata mode

text_shaping.purpose: Convert a safe base response into a phone-friendly spoken form while preserving the same factual content and sales boundary.
disallowed_inputs: claims not already present in the base text
buyer_facing_safety_notes: Keep the buyer-facing text free of internal labels and backend names.
Do not add new commitments, appointments, emails, CRM actions, or product claims.

punctuation.purpose: Use ordinary punctuation to make the same response easier to speak and listen to.
allowed_inputs: periods for one idea per sentence
question marks only when the response intentionally asks a buyer question
buyer_facing_safety_notes: Punctuation must not imply fake side effects or urgency.
Terminal and boundary responses must not add a new question.

sentence_length.purpose: Keep phone-call sentences short enough for natural TTS delivery and buyer comprehension.
buyer_facing_safety_notes: Use one idea per sentence for confused buyers.
Use concise final sentences for terminal closes.
Do not make the response longer than the base meaning requires.

pause_hinting_by_punctuation.purpose: Represent future pause intent with safe punctuation metadata instead of raw tags or audio generation.
buyer_facing_safety_notes: Any punctuation added to spoken text must remain natural and ordinary.

emphasis_by_word_choice.purpose: Choose plain emphasis targets from the planner without adding markup or capitalized shouting.
allowed_inputs: safe product nouns already present in base_text
buyer_facing_safety_notes: Emphasis terms are metadata for review.
Do not add manipulative urgency or overexcited sales language.

style_prompt_hint.purpose: Create a future-provider style hint that can be reviewed before any approved provider sample phase.
allowed_inputs: safe delivery family inferred from labels
buyer_facing_safety_notes: Style hints are metadata only and must not be spoken to the buyer.
Keep style grounded, calm, and truthful.

voice_settings_hint.purpose: Represent a conservative future voice-settings suggestion without calling ElevenLabs or assuming exact provider behavior.
buyer_facing_safety_notes: Voice settings are review metadata only.
They must not claim audio was generated or tested.

text_shaping_examples.confused buyer: Short sentences, slower explanatory phrasing, one idea per sentence.
text_shaping_examples.price objection: Acknowledge first, then value frame, no pressure.
text_shaping_examples.terminal close: Concise final sentence, no new question.
text_shaping_examples.already told you: Acknowledge, summarize known context, do not repeat the same question.
text_shaping_examples.ASR uncertainty: Natural clarification, no classifier or confidence language.
